note: Reviewed CDB90 match 47, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: Volvera municipal history and the Italian Ministry of Culture identify the complete battle on 4 October 1693, French army under Catinat versus the allied army under Victor Amadeus II. Both source forces remain local; the allied total is not reduced to Savoy alone. Subsequent plunder is distinct from battle casualties. Identity review (attacker; original CDB90 name FR ARMY): CDB FR ARMY / CATINAT is the French army in the institutional historical account. Original strength and casualty estimates are preserved. Identity review (defender; original CDB90 name ALLIED ARMY): CDB ALLIED ARMY / DUKE OF SAVOY represents the combined army, not just Savoyard troops. The municipal and ministry accounts identify its commander and opposing complete force.
